title: Furniture & Mattresses — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Furniture & Mattresses Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

batchLotNumber.title: Batch or Serial Number
batchLotNumber.description: Batch ID or serial number for traceability and recalls
batchLotNumber.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(5) — type, batch, serial number or other identifying element

productCategory.title: Product Category
productCategory.description: Product type within furniture scope (seating, table, bed, mattress, storage, etc.)

countryOfManufacture.title: Country of Manufacture
countryOfManufacture.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of manufacturing

passportIssuer.title: Passport Issuer
passportIssuer.description: Entity legally responsible for creating and updating the DPP

dataCarrierType.title: Data Carrier Type
dataCarrierType.description: Type of data carrier (QR code, RFID, NFC, Data Matrix, GS1 Digital Link)

billOfMaterials.title: Bill of Materials
billOfMaterials.description: Structured list of all materials by component with weight percentages

totalProductWeightKg.title: Total Product Weight
totalProductWeightKg.description: Total weight of the finished product in kilograms

recycledContentPercentage.title: Recycled Content Percentage
recycledContentPercentage.description: Total recycled content as percentage of product weight

renewableMaterialContentPercentage.title: Renewable Material Content
renewableMaterialContentPercentage.description: Percentage of materials from renewable biological sources

woodSpecies.title: Wood Species
woodSpecies.description: Species of wood used (common and scientific name)
woodSpecies.x-provision: EUDR (EU) 2023/1115 Art. 4 — due diligence statement lodged in the EU Information System by the operator

forestCertificationScheme.title: Forest Certification Scheme
forestCertificationScheme.description: Forest certification (FSC, PEFC, or equivalent). Required for virgin wood.
forestCertificationScheme.x-provision: FSC / PEFC are voluntary certification schemes; EUDR mandates due diligence, not certification

chainOfCustodyCertificate.title: Chain of Custody Certificate
chainOfCustodyCertificate.description: Chain of Custody certificate number proving traceability from forest to product

countryOfHarvest.title: Country of Harvest
countryOfHarvest.description: Country where the wood was harvested (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
countryOfHarvest.x-provision: EUDR (EU) 2023/1115 Art. 4 — due diligence statement lodged in the EU Information System by the operator

deforestationFreeDeclaration.title: Deforestation-Free Declaration
deforestationFreeDeclaration.description: Declaration that wood is deforestation-free per EUDR cut-off date (31 Dec 2020)
deforestationFreeDeclaration.x-provision: EUDR (EU) 2023/1115 Art. 4 — due diligence statement lodged in the EU Information System by the operator

geolocationOfHarvest.title: Geolocation of Harvest
geolocationOfHarvest.description: GPS coordinates or polygon of the plot of land where timber was harvested
geolocationOfHarvest.x-provision: EUDR (EU) 2023/1115 Art. 4 — due diligence statement lodged in the EU Information System by the operator

svhcCandidateListSubstances.title: SVHC Candidate List Substances
svhcCandidateListSubstances.description: Substances of Very High Concern on REACH candidate list present above 0.1% w/w
svhcCandidateListSubstances.x-provision: REACH (EC) 1907/2006 Art. 33(1) — to B2B recipients on request, above 0.1% w/w, minimum content the substance name

formaldehydeEmissionClass.title: Formaldehyde Emission Class
formaldehydeEmissionClass.description: Formaldehyde emission class of wood-based panels (E0.5, E1, etc.)
formaldehydeEmissionClass.x-provision: REACH Annex XVII entry 77 — market-placement limit (0.062 mg/m3)

formaldehydeEmissionValueMgM3.title: Formaldehyde Emission Value (mg/m3)
formaldehydeEmissionValueMgM3.description: Formaldehyde emission measured per EN 717-1 chamber test (mg/m3). Must be <= 0.062 mg/m3 for furniture from Aug 2026.
formaldehydeEmissionValueMgM3.x-provision: REACH Annex XVII entry 77 — market-placement limit (0.062 mg/m3)

vocEmissionClass.title: VOC Emission Class
vocEmissionClass.description: Total VOC emission class or value per EN 16516 or equivalent
vocEmissionClass.x-provision: Reg. (EC) 66/2010 Art. 1 — the EU Ecolabel is a VOLUNTARY award scheme

totalVocEmissionUgM3.title: Total VOC Emission (ug/m3)
totalVocEmissionUgM3.description: Total VOC emission after 28 days (ug/m3) per EN 16516
totalVocEmissionUgM3.x-standard: EN 16516 (determination of emissions into indoor air)

flameRetardantSubstances.title: Flame Retardant Substances
flameRetardantSubstances.description: List of flame retardant chemicals used, if any. Halogenated flame retardants under ECHA scrutiny.
flameRetardantSubstances.x-provision: POPs Reg. (EU) 2019/1021 Annex I — market restriction

pbdeContentMgKg.title: PBDE Content (mg/kg)
pbdeContentMgKg.description: Total PBDE (polybrominated diphenyl ethers) content in mg/kg. Unintentional trace limit 10 mg/kg; higher phased limits apply to articles containing recycled material.
pbdeContentMgKg.x-provision: POPs Reg. (EU) 2019/1021 Annex I (as amended by Del. Reg. (EU) 2025/1482) — unintentional trace limit 10 mg/kg

biocidesUsed.title: Biocides Used
biocidesUsed.description: List of biocidal products used in treatment (wood preservatives, etc.)

applicableDurabilityStandard.title: Applicable Durability Standard
applicableDurabilityStandard.description: EN standard applied for durability/strength testing
applicableDurabilityStandard.x-standard: EN durability/strength test standards (named per product family)

durabilityTestLevel.title: Durability Test Level
durabilityTestLevel.description: Test severity level passed (e.g. Level 1 = domestic light, Level 2 = domestic general, Level 3 = domestic severe)

testCyclesCompleted.title: Test Cycles Completed
testCyclesCompleted.description: Number of load/use cycles completed during durability testing

maximumUserWeightKg.title: Maximum User Weight (kg)
maximumUserWeightKg.description: Maximum user weight the product is designed for (seating/beds)

expectedProductLifetimeYears.title: Expected Product Lifetime (years)
expectedProductLifetimeYears.description: Estimated product lifetime under normal use conditions

warrantyPeriodYears.title: Warranty Period (years)
warrantyPeriodYears.description: Commercial warranty period offered ESPR Art. 7(2)(a) mandates no data on its own and no furniture delegated act exists; the statutory guarantee under Dir. (EU) 2019/771 binds the seller.

repairabilityScore.title: Repairability Score
repairabilityScore.description: Repairability index or score (scale/methodology TBD in delegated act)

foamType.title: Foam Type
foamType.description: Type of foam used (PU, HR, memory, latex, etc.)
foamType.x-provision: Reg. (EC) 66/2010 Art. 1 — the EU Ecolabel is a VOLUNTARY award scheme

foamWeightKg.title: Foam Weight (kg)
foamWeightKg.description: Total weight of foam components in the mattress
foamWeightKg.x-provision: Reg. (EC) 66/2010 Art. 1 — the EU Ecolabel is a VOLUNTARY award scheme

foamDensityKgM3.title: Foam Density (kg/m3)
foamDensityKgM3.description: Density of the primary foam layer (kg/m3)

springType.title: Spring Type
springType.description: Type of spring system (pocket, Bonnell, continuous, etc.)

mattressCoverRemovable.title: Mattress Cover Removable
mattressCoverRemovable.description: Whether mattress cover is removable and washable
mattressCoverRemovable.x-provision: Reg. (EC) 66/2010 Art. 1 — the EU Ecolabel is a VOLUNTARY award scheme

carbonFootprint.title: Carbon Footprint (kg CO2e)
carbonFootprint.description: Total product carbon footprint in kg CO2-equivalent (cradle-to-gate or cradle-to-grave as specified)

carbonFootprintMethodology.title: Carbon Footprint Methodology
carbonFootprintMethodology.description: Methodology used for carbon footprint calculation

environmentalProductDeclarationUrl.title: Environmental Product Declaration URL
environmentalProductDeclarationUrl.description: URL to the Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) if available

energyUsedInManufacturingKwh.title: Energy Used in Manufacturing (kWh)
energyUsedInManufacturingKwh.description: Total energy consumed during manufacturing per unit

waterUsedInManufacturingLiters.title: Water Used in Manufacturing (liters)
waterUsedInManufacturingLiters.description: Total water consumed during manufacturing per unit

disassemblyInstructionsUrl.title: Disassembly Instructions URL
disassemblyInstructionsUrl.description: URL or URI to professional disassembly instructions for end-of-life treatment

consumerRepairInstructionsUrl.title: Consumer Repair Instructions URL
consumerRepairInstructionsUrl.description: URL or URI to consumer-facing repair and maintenance instructions

sparePartsAvailabilityYears.title: Spare Parts Availability (years)
sparePartsAvailabilityYears.description: Period (years) during which spare parts are available after last unit placed on market

sparePartsList.title: Spare Parts List
sparePartsList.description: List of available spare parts with ordering information

recyclabilityPercentage.title: Recyclability Percentage
recyclabilityPercentage.description: Percentage of product weight that is recyclable at end of life

disassemblyTimeMinutes.title: Disassembly Time (minutes)
disassemblyTimeMinutes.description: Estimated time to fully disassemble for recycling (minutes)

toolsRequiredForDisassembly.title: Tools Required for Disassembly
toolsRequiredForDisassembly.description: List of tools needed for product disassembly

declarationOfConformityUrl.title: Declaration of Conformity URL
declarationOfConformityUrl.description: URL to EU Declaration of Conformity document

flammabilityTestStandard.title: Flammability Test Standard
flammabilityTestStandard.description: Fire safety / flammability standard the product meets

reachCompliance.title: REACH Compliance
reachCompliance.x-provision: REACH (EC) 1907/2006 — obligations evidenced in the manufacturer's records

scipNotificationNumber.title: SCIP Notification Number
scipNotificationNumber.description: ECHA SCIP database notification number (if product contains SVHC > 0.1% w/w)

intendedUse.title: Intended Use
intendedUse.description: Intended use environment (domestic, commercial, outdoor, etc.)

careInstructions.title: Care Instructions
careInstructions.description: Care and maintenance instructions for the end user

safetyWarnings.title: Safety Warnings
safetyWarnings.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(7) — warnings and safety information, where the product's risks require them

supplyChainActors.title: Supply Chain Actors
supplyChainActors.description: Key supply chain actors involved in production (tiered)

dueDiligenceStatementUrl.title: Due Diligence Statement URL
dueDiligenceStatementUrl.description: URL to due diligence statement per EUDR or CSDDD

dppSchemaVersion.title: DPP Schema Version
dppSchemaVersion.description: Version of the DPP schema used
